# Credits {.unnumbered}

The chapter list was constructed by surveying 12
publicly-available syllabi from major US biostatistics
programmes (documented in `docs/syllabi-survey.md`) and
adopting the topics that appeared in three or more of them.

The chapter template (Learning objectives → Orientation →
Statistician's contribution → content with
Check-your-understanding callouts → Collaborating with an
LLM → Exercises → Further reading) follows the structure
established in the companion volumes
*Statistical Computing in the Age of AI* and
*Biostatistics Practicum*.

Visual design, the two-zone Springer-style cover, the
SCSS theme, the navigation toggle, is shared across all
three books in the series, with palette differentiation
per volume.

Cover artwork generated procedurally by the Python script
at `images/build-cover.py`. Watercolour palette: deep wine
through plum and rose to warm amber, anchored on the
brand burgundy `#7a2c4e`. Typography: Avenir family
(Apple system font); body text in Source Serif 4.

Acknowledgements to the authors of *R for Data Science*,
*Advanced R*, *R Packages*, *Bayesian Data Analysis*,
*Statistical Rethinking*, and the Posit and tidyverse
communities, whose published work and toolchain make the
modern R-based statistical book possible.
